title: 3-Ingredient Brazilian Brigadeiro Truffles
hookLine: Fudgy, melt-in-your-mouth chocolate caramel truffles made with just 3 pantry staples.

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {cond_milk} and {cocoa_br} and {butter_br} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Cook Fudge Until Pan-Pull Stage
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {cond_milk}, {cocoa_br}, and {butter_br} in a nonstick saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring constantly for 9–10 minutes until the mixture parts cleanly when you tilt the pan.
steps.creatorSecret: Do not rush on high heat—medium-low prevents scorching and builds shiny caramel chew.

steps.title: Roll Into Glossy Truffles
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour onto a buttered plate, chill 20 mins, then roll into bite-sized balls with lightly buttered hands and coat in chocolate sprinkles.
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as 3-Ingredient Brazilian Brigadeiro Truffles coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 12 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 15 mins.
